info.title: Yahoo Finance Web Market Data API
info.description: Unofficial metadata for undocumented, read-only JSON endpoints used by provider-owned Yahoo Finance pages. Yahoo does not publish or support these endpoints as a public Finance developer API; paths, fields, authentication and availability may change without notice. The provider-owned Help pages cited below document the corresponding user-facing chart, historical-data and search features, not this wire protocol. Observed properties are deliberately modeled as open, non-exhaustive shapes and are not an official contract. Yahoo Help says displayed information is informational, may have exchange delays and must not be redistributed; Yahoo Terms also prohibit automated collection without prior permission. Review the applicable terms and data-provider restrictions before access or reuse.

get.summary: Get chart and historical price data
get.description: Get chart and historical price data. Observed anonymously on both query1 and query2 on 2026-08-10; compatibility is not guaranteed. Yahoo's user-facing chart supports date ranges and intervals, but does not document this JSON protocol. Array members under `indicators` align by index with `timestamp` and can contain nulls.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Yahoo Finance symbol exactly as used in quote-page URLs. Examples include US equity `AAPL`, index `^GSPC`, and exchange-suffixed `0700.HK`.
